question: How should worship and recitation proceed after this meditation?
premises: Worship is performed on the seat taught for Shridhara
Muttering and related acts follow in the same manner
inference: After meditating, one should worship on the Shridhara-taught seat and perform muttering and so on in the same way.
plain_english: Having meditated, one should worship on the seat taught for Shridhara and perform muttering and so on in the same manner.
